summary: Construct a DataView over an ArrayBuffer or SharedArrayBuffer with byte offset/length semantics.

semantics.length_tracking: when byteLength omitted on resizable/growable backing store
semantics.throws: RangeError for out-of-range offset/length; TypeError for invalid/detached buffer

tests.name: shared view
tests.input: const b=new ArrayBuffer(4); const v=new DataView(b,1,2); v.setUint8(0,7); console.log(new Uint8Array(b)[1],v.byteLength);
